bands.label: Enemy
bands.greeting: They do not meet your eyes.
bands.blurb: There is no road back from this without a debt paid.

bands.label: Rival
bands.greeting: They watch you the way a hawk watches a field.
bands.blurb: Respect with an edge on it.

bands.label: Stranger
bands.greeting: They take your measure, and no more.

bands.label: Acquaintance
bands.greeting: They nod as you come near.
bands.blurb: A name you both know now.

bands.label: Friend
bands.greeting: Their face warms when they see you.
bands.blurb: Someone who would hear you out.

bands.label: Sworn friend
bands.greeting: They wave you over like family.

ties.label: Mentor
ties.blurb: Someone whose teaching shaped another's road.

ties.label: Kin
ties.blurb: Blood, or the oath that stands in for it.
